question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Solitary
solution: The correct answer is **"Single."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Solitary"** means (used about a person or an animal) enjoying being alone; frequently spending time alone, only one. ((व्‍यक्ति या पशु) एकांतप्रेमी; अकेले समय यापन करते रहने वाला, एकांतसेनी)) • **Example**:* She was always a **solitary**__ child.* • Synonyms of **Solitary** include **Single**, Alone, Lonely, and Isolated. • **"Single"** means only one. (केवल एक) __ • **Example**: *I managed to finish the whole job in a **single**__ afternoon.* • The correct answer is option 3. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Joyful"**, means feeling or expressing great happiness or pleasure. (बहुत प्रसन्‍न, ख़ुश या आनंदित) • **Option 2, "Hardship"**, means severe suffering or privation. (पर्याप्त धन, भोजन आदि का अभाव, जीवन की मूलभूत सुविधाओं की अपर्याप्ता; तंगहाली) • **Option 4, "Awkward"**, means causing difficulty; hard to do or deal with. (निपटने में मुश्किल, कठिन, कष्‍टकर) 35:Tce7, The correct answer is **"rude."**
